# Archive

**Frozen on 2026-11-11.** Do not edit these documents; they are kept for reference.

On 2026-11-11 (phase F0) the project switched from the layered workflow (L0–L7 gates,
`STATUS.md`, handoffs) to a phase-based workflow. The current project state, phases and
decisions live in [`../ARQUITECTURA.md`](../ARQUITECTURA.md) (Spanish).

The documents here stay because code, tests, ADRs and evidence still cite their IDs:
`REQ-F-*` / `REQ-NF-*`, `DEC-*`, `OPEN-*`, `CONFLICT-*` and `HIL-*`.

| Path | What it was |
|---|---|
| [`layers/STATUS.md`](layers/STATUS.md) | Layer gates, full text of DEC/OPEN/CONFLICT entries |
| [`layers/00-vision/vision.md`](layers/00-vision/vision.md) | L0 vision and scope |
| [`layers/01-requirements/requirements.md`](layers/01-requirements/requirements.md) | L1 requirements (REQ-IDs) |
| [`layers/02-architecture/architecture.md`](layers/02-architecture/architecture.md) | L2 architecture and diagrams |
| [`layers/process/workflow.md`](layers/process/workflow.md) | The layered workflow itself |

Only relative links were updated after the move so they keep resolving.
